overall: MARGINAL TO POOR: the Coron side, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo fish well; the east side stays shut by wind into Friday afternoon
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a combination , led by east wind at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (13–22.1 kt through the next 24h), plus current at Decabaitot (1.5–1.6 kt about 10 AM–1 PM Friday), Barangonan (1.5 kt about 10 PM–midnight) and Alava (1.1–1.4 kt tonight and Friday late morning). Rain is minor: 0.5–0.7 mm/h at Barangonan about midnight–5 AM, elsewhere 0–0.3 mm/h.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still lists an older tropical cyclone alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) that doesn't name Palawan; worth a glance on the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The east wind now lasts through Friday midday, so Sat 7 supply drops from NORMAL to NEAR NORMAL. Nangalao is forecast at 20.5–22.1 kt from about 1 AM to 11 AM Friday, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 19.7–21.5 kt from about 2 AM to noon, and Ciron 18.8–19.7 kt from about 2 AM to 1 PM. This morning the build looked like it ended around 5 AM Friday.

Sun 8 goes back to SLIGHTLY SOFT (was near normal) because Saturday is now the roughest day of the week (12 kt, gusts 19, dry). Fri 6 stays SLIGHTLY SOFT, leaning softer. The count is still 5 GOOD / 4 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 0 VERY POOR , but the mix shifted: Linapacan and Alava fell to POOR on 0.9 kt current and 12 kt wind, while Tara and Turda recovered to MARGINAL. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). The dashboard's shortage detector stays ELEVATED for Thu–Wed (guide only; it reacts to the 0.6 kt daily currents). Tightening risk is now moderate to high: four soft or below-normal arrival days in a row (Wed 4 to Sat 7), and the east grounds will have missed about 48 hours by Friday noon. Lean on the Coron side, Galoc, Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo for Friday and Saturday supply.

bestWindow.headline: About 4 PM today through Friday midday on the Coron side; all day at Panlaitan, Maglalambay and Decabobo
details: Coron and Galoc: 3.9–5.8 kt from about 4 PM onward, current 0.1–0.3. Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 0.8–8.5 kt with 0.1–0.3 kt current all day. Decabobo: 0.5–5 kt, current 0.2–0.5. Tara and Turda: wind is light, so go about 9 PM–1 AM or 10 AM–1 PM Friday when the current eases to 0.5–0.7 kt. Binudac: easiest about 11 AM–1 PM Friday (under 5 kt, current 0.9). East side: no usable window in the next 24h; the lightest spell is Ciron at 13–14 kt about 8 PM–midnight.
Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan tonight and Friday morning (up to 22 kt).
